Flathub carries two genuinely different apps both displaying as "Vice"/"VICE": io.github.mmp.Vice is an air traffic control simulator, net.sf.VICE is the real, unrelated VICE multi-platform Commodore 8-bit emulator -- same bare normalized name ("vice"), coincidence only. net.sf.VICE is also the real emulator's own canonical id (see config/match-force.json, which reattaches Debian/Ubuntu/Arch/Nix/RPM Fusion/Void/Solus/Gentoo/AUR's vice-svn to it). Same generic-name-collision shape as group.ts's GENERIC_NAME_BLOCKLIST entries (singularity/ace/bass), but unlike those the real emulator legitimately uses the bare colliding name everywhere (including on Flathub itself), so blocklisting "vice" globally would explode its correct multi-source merge instead of fixing this one false one -- needs a per-pair deny against every real member instead (see the sibling entries below, one per source since union-find only needs one surviving edge into the merged cluster to pull the ATC simulator back in). Found live surfaced while working the games "To Classify" bucket (2026-09-02): the merged group carried both a game and an emulator, with hasGameCategory only true for the Flathub ATC-simulator side.
